summary: The library urges the FCC to preserve the core E-Rate program to ensure continued access to affordable internet services and library services.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate threatens to leave vulnerable communities behind that don't have the resources to fill the gap
claims.evidence_quote: Cutting E-Rate threatens to leave vulnerable communities behind that don't have the resources to fill the gap. In our case, the library's budget will be severely affected, jeopardizing all library services, not just the years libraries have been providing fast affordable access to reliable and sustainable internet services. Continued support is essential to all libraries to fulfill our mission to enrich lives, enable success, and build community by bringing people, information, and ideas together.
